bear_assumptions: Apply 20 times the USD 7.10 adjusted EPS guidance low as fixed-price charges, Pratt powder-metal remediation, supplier constraints, leverage, or commercial normalization limit conversion of the USD 289 billion backlog into durable per-share cash flow.
base_assumptions: Apply 25 times the USD 7.175 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint as defense backlog and commercial aftermarket demand support growth, while remediation, USD 29.078 billion of net debt, contract execution, and cycle normalization constrain the multiple.
bull_assumptions: Apply 32 times the USD 7.25 adjusted EPS guidance high as funded awards, qualified output, segment margins, aftermarket demand, remediation progress, and USD 8.50-8.75 billion free-cash-flow guidance delivery all outperform without material dilution or new liabilities.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, and relationship gates after the overbought condition normalizes or fundamental value rises; downgrade further if fixed-price losses, Pratt liabilities, leverage, supply constraints, award delays, commercial demand, compliance obligations, or cash-flow delivery deteriorate.
